topic.topic: The Rosetta of the sea: the Phoenician alphabet
topic.angle: Where our letters trace back to a trading people and a few dozen signs

card.title: The alphabet of the sea traders

body.question: The Phoenician script was one of the first alphabets, used across the Mediterranean for most of the 1st millennium BC. How many letters did it have?
body.reveal: Just 22 letters, all of them consonants: it was an abjad that left vowels implicit. Its descendants include the Aramaic script and the Archaic Greek alphabets, which repurposed some letters to write vowels.

probes.question: True or false: the Archaic Greek alphabets are direct descendants of the Phoenician script.
What type of writing system is the Phoenician script?
